_comment: Medic drone cosmetic mounts, game coordinates (metres) relative to the body origin; the drone faces -z. Centres lie exactly on the flat panel faces; offset planes ~0.5 mm along the normal to avoid z-fighting. width runs along z for the side panels and along x for the top; height along y for the sides and along z for the top. panel* gives the full flat face, width/height the recommended decal area inside its rounded corners.
